ICS 59.060.10TXD 04Revised Standard from Last Update.1. ScopeThis standard specifies testing methods for identification, labelling and marking of Pashmina products by using the light microscopy (LM), the scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and DNA -polymerase chain reaction (PCR) method. This standard is applicable to raw fibre, sliver, yarn, dyed/processed fabrics and finished products made of atleast 90 percent of pashmina fibres.NOTE - The product shall be marked and labeled as pashmina product if it contains atleast 90 percent of pashmina fibres in the product.
